title: Inspectors; duties.
bodyText: The director shall appoint inspectors, each of whom shall receive from the director a card or badge authorizing the person to act as inspector whenever the director may designate the person to so act.
bodyHtml: [§440E-14]  Inspectors; duties.  The director shall appoint inspectors, each of whom shall receive from the director a card or badge authorizing the person to act as inspector whenever the director may designate the person to so act. [L 2007, c 279, pt of §1]
